jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Concealed Carbs
seedTermsUsed: Having to hide or escape detection
jokes.joke: I saw my personal trainer at the supermarket while I was buying a whole birthday cake. I panicked and hid it under my jacket. Security stopped me, and I actually felt relieved. I would rather explain this cake to a judge than explain it to a man who says, “Let’s earn our weekend.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Cardio Fugitive
seedTermsUsed: Having to hide or escape detection
jokes.joke: I hired a personal trainer, which I now realize was just paying someone to help me hide from myself. Every session he finds me. Behind the water fountain, in the sauna, once I hid inside a vending machine between the protein bars. He still finds me. Turns out you cannot outrun a man whose entire job is finding you. I’ve started billing it as cardio.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Short-Term Memory Gains
jokes.joke: My personal trainer is so forgetful that he makes me pay for the session twice, and yesterday he spent twenty minutes spotting me on a bench press before asking what muscle group we were targeting. I told him we were working on my patience, and he nodded, jotted it down on his clipboard, and immediately asked why I was lying on the floor.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Spotty Memory
jokes.joke: I'm a personal trainer, but I'm so forgetful it's borderline dangerous. A client will be mid-set and ask how many reps are left. I'll freeze and go, 'Uh... the same number as last time?' Yesterday a guy asked me to spot his bench. I forgot why I was standing over him and walked off to check my phone. He's fine. His bar is still deciding whether to come down.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Rep Counter
jokes.joke: I hired a personal trainer who warned me he was a little forgetful. I thought, how bad could that be? Halfway through a workout he looked at me and said, “Great progress. What are we training for?” I said, “My wedding.” He nodded and handed me a basketball. By the end of the session I was in the best shape of my life for a completely different guy’s wedding.

The basketball introduces a mismatch, but the different man's wedding does not follow or deliver a clear laugh.
